top_5_fixes: Fix spoofable owner checks in _posts.js and _polls.js
Cache isAdmin() and buildChain() results per-request

issues.title: No auth check - any user can read/create/delete any user's notifications
issues.fix: Add checkUser() on GET and DELETE. Add isAdmin() on POST.

issues.title: No auth check - exposes ban/suspension status of any user
issues.fix: Add checkUser() gate and verify caller anon_id matches queried anon_id.

issues.title: No rate limiting on registration/heartbeat
issues.fix: Add rateLimited() with strict limit (60 req/5min).

issues.title: Public health endpoint exposes internal metrics
issues.fix: Add isAdmin() gate or shared secret header.

issues.title: Wildcard injection via unescaped ilike pattern
issues.fix: Escape LIKE metacharacters: q.replace(/[%_\\]/g, '\\$&')

issues.title: Wildcard injection in LLM search_content tool
issues.fix: Escape LIKE metacharacters. Whitelist bulk_update columns per table.

issues.title: Public endpoint leaks provider config and API key suffixes
issues.fix: Add isAdmin() gate to ?action=list.

issues.title: Thread state save has no error handling
issues.fix: Add try/catch around setThreadState with retry.

issues.title: No timeout on overall pre-publish check
issues.fix: Wrap Promise.all in Race with 30s timeout.

issues.title: Purge throttle ineffective across serverless instances
issues.fix: Persist _lastPurgeAt in settings table.

issues.title: No rate limit on admin takeover/release/transfer
issues.fix: Add rateLimited() to admin actions. Cap notification array at 50.

issues.title: No admin auth - exposes full platform trend data
issues.fix: Add isAdmin() gate.

issues.title: No auth on timeline event creation
issues.fix: Add isAdmin() or checkUser() gate.

issues.title: Base64 data-URL fallback can blow up DB storage
issues.fix: Reject uploads when storage is unavailable.

issues.title: No auth on routing stats endpoint
issues.fix: Add isAdmin() gate.

issues.title: Spoofable owner check - any user can delete any poll
issues.fix: Use session identity, not request body author_id.

issues.title: Spoofable owner check - any user can edit/delete any post
issues.fix: Use caller identity from session, not request body.

issues.title: Instant ban with no confirmation step
issues.fix: Require confirmation token for ban actions.

issues.title: No caching on provider chain - DB hit per LLM call
issues.fix: Cache provider chain with 60s TTL.

issues.title: LLM-generated query plans execute against DB
issues.fix: Whitelist allowed tables/columns for query_plan.

issues.title: No auth - exposes internal latency and user counts
issues.fix: Add isAdmin() gate.

issues.title: In-memory rate limits reset on cold start
issues.fix: Use Supabase for persistent rate limiting.

issues.title: isAdmin() queries DB on every call - no caching
issues.fix: Cache admin status per-request.

issues.title: thread_id not validated for format
issues.fix: Validate thread_id matches UUID or expected format.

issues.title: No minimum query length
issues.fix: Require q.length >= 2.

issues.title: emergencyRegex has potential regex DoS on crafted input
issues.fix: Add input length limits before regex evaluation.

issues.title: _tableExists cache never invalidates
issues.fix: Re-check table existence periodically or on error.

issues.title: storeInSettings read-modify-write without locking
issues.fix: Use a transaction or optimistic locking with version counter.

issues.title: Duplicate detection fetches only 50 posts
issues.fix: Increase limit or use DB-level similarity search.

issues.title: Events can exceed MAX_EVENTS across cold starts
issues.fix: Persist last purge timestamp in settings table.

issues.title: No timeout on evidence scan LLM calls
issues.fix: Add AbortController with 25s timeout.

issues.title: Rate limit is per-thread, not per-IP
issues.fix: Add IP-based rate limiting in addition to thread-based.

issues.title: Inconsistent response shapes across GET/POST
issues.fix: Standardize all responses to {data, meta} envelope.

issues.title: author_id masking uses multi-byte ellipsis character
issues.fix: Use ASCII '...' instead of '...'.

issues.title: GET ?action=list returns ~15KB payload with 50+ providers
issues.fix: Add pagination or filtering.

issues.title: Health check returns raw Postgres error messages
issues.fix: Sanitize to status: 'error' without raw error text.

issues.title: 404 handler calls corsFn(res) without req parameter
issues.fix: Pass req: corsFn(res, req) on 404 responses.

issues.title: Cleanup runs on cold start only - stale data persists on warm instances
issues.fix: Add a scheduled cron trigger or periodic check.

issues.title: Announcement body accepts raw HTML/markdown without sanitization
issues.fix: Sanitize with DOMPurify before storage.

issues.title: logActivity and recordMetric silently swallow errors
issues.fix: Add retry logic or dead-letter queue for failed logs.

issues.title: recordMetric does nothing if agent_executions table missing
issues.fix: Log a warning when metrics are silently dropped.
